rollbacks._note: A rollback on purpose (S12-161): "<fn>": { "from": "<the live build main rolls back>", "why": "..." }. A function whose live build is exactly `from` is deployed at main's build by the next message, and section 49 FAILs it until production answers main's. Any other function live ahead of main stays exit 8: a build nobody declared is never rolled back by a pasted message. Remove the entry once section 49 passes it.

_holdUntilVerifiedNote: Each hold names releaseWhen (S12-032): the functions and builds the ledger reads from the preflight; when every one is live the hold is RELEASABLE, the message says so instead of 'Do NOT apply yet', and section 49 FAILs until it is released. `until` keeps what only the owner can check. A hold with no releaseWhen the ledger can read stops the message (exit 6).

migrationOrder._note: Per migration stamp: `after` is "fn:<name>@<YYYY-MM-DD.N>" (apply once that function answers that build or later) or "frontend" (apply once the frontend is published); `before` lists "fn:<name>" a migration must precede. No entry: before the functions. The ledger prints five steps: migrations before the functions, the functions, migrations after the functions they wait for, the frontend, migrations after the frontend (docs/DEPLOY-LEDGER.md §1).
